why: My Hero Academia: I am a hero too is a single episode summer 2026 special: anilist gives start and end 2026-08-03 with one episode, mal 2026-08-03 with one, kitsu 2026-08-02 with one, and offline one, so the four members agree on the work and differ only by a day on the date. cr:GE00379883JAJP holds the run: it is a Crunchyroll watch container with no count and no dates, and kitsu:50701 declares the special PART_OF it. nf:80135674 holds the run: it is the bare Netflix title container for My Hero Academia, carrying no count and no episode dates but 183 episodes of the parent series (Izuku Midoriya: Origin onward, plus Memories 1 and Toshinori Yagi: Rising/Origin), and it claims the same run through anilist:211711, kitsu:50701, mal:64107 and offline:mal-64107. Neither hold gets a range: the Netflix episodes carry no release dates and the run has no episode titles of its own to align against.
